name: Summer Scholars Internship
org: Center for Brooklyn History (Brooklyn Public Library)
what_you_do: Work with archivists, historians and teachers on Brooklyn history. You do research in the Othmer Library. You see how exhibits are made. You visit museums, archives and historic sites.
who_can_apply: Rising 10th, 11th and 12th graders who live in Brooklyn or go to school in Brooklyn. A strong interest in Brooklyn's past.
pay_detail: Pay is not stated on the page. Ask CBH Education whether there is a stipend.
duration: Summer. The 2026 program had a final reception; exact weeks and hours are not stated.
deadline_text: The page says applications for the 2026 program are closed. The 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: The page does not give steps. It says the 2026 application is closed. Questions: CBHEducation@bklynlibrary.org.
notes: Confirm first: pay, exact dates and application steps are not on the page we read (it showed the 2026 application as closed). Ask CBH Education whether it is paid.
